conviction_note: The period being reported (Aug-2026, DPU forecast 3,112 yen) was pre-released by the 2026-03-23 revision. The print turns on the first Aug-2027 guide and on any capital return. On the guide, refinancing costs are rising and two properties sit vacant, which leans negative (-0.30). On capital return, a peer buyback wave and MEL's own 2025 results-day buyback lean positive (+0.35). The two roughly cancel (impact_sum +0.10), so p_up stays at 50 and the scaled number is 0. abs_move_pct is about twice the 0.64 proxy, because a new-period guide is due and last April's guide moved the stock -3.2%.
bar: Company forecast for the Aug-2026 period (20th period): DPU 3,112 yen including excess distribution (2,829 ex-OPD), ordinary profit 4,202m yen, per the 2026-02 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260416505399.pdf (revised from 2,835 yen on 2026-03-23, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260323/140120260323586855.pdf). Feb-2027 forecast DPU 2,836 yen (2,458 ex-OPD, 378 OPD). Management's revised target is an annual-average DPU of 2,936 yen (logmi transcript of the 2026-04-17 results briefing, https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/384449). No 四季報 or IFIS consensus was reachable (Yahoo earningsHistory is empty), so the bar is the company plan only. Every finding is capped small for that reason.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-10-16: 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, unchanged (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the sealed baseline). 信用倍率 9.63 (scraped, per the baseline), so margin longs are heavy against shorts, though for a J-REIT priced at 108,500 yen that is a small retail overhang. There are no options and no skew. priced_lean_pct is -0.28 (margin overhang -0.49, run-up +0.22). The 20-day run-up of -4.32% is mostly the sector: the TSE REIT ETF 1343 went from 1,901 on 09-09 to 1,814 on 10-19 (-4.6%) (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/1343.T?range=3y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: The first Aug-2027 guide lands on rising debt costs and known vacancies. On 2026-10-09, 2.8bn yen maturing at 0.26% fixed was refinanced at 2.41-2.47% fixed. On 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-14, 2.21bn yen at 0.25-0.51% fixed went to TIBOR+0.255-0.28% floating, and 3.88bn more falls due 2026-10-26. Management also flagged downtime at two vacated properties for Feb-2027. The Feb-2027 forecast already needs 378 yen of OPD to hold 2,836, against the 2,936 annual-average target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2026-04-16 print the first Feb-2027 guide (2,836 total, ex-OPD down to 2,458 from 2,600) was followed by -3.21% against -0.74% for the REIT ETF 1343. At the 2025-10-16 print, guides of 2,832/2,835 drew -0.16% (ETF -0.21%) (Yahoo chart, 3481.T).
findings.why_not_priced: The refinancing rates are public, and the stock is already down 17% since April (ETF about -14%), so most of the rate story is in the price. What is not yet published is how management will bridge to 2,936 in the Aug-2027 guide: OPD, another sale gain, or a lower number. If the market had fully priced a cut, the stock would not be trading in line with the sector over 20 days (-4.3% against -4.6%).
findings.independence: The April interest assumption (520m yen for Aug-2026 rising to 570m for Feb-2027, with the Sep/Oct refinancings listed) is in the 決算短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260416505399.pdf. The vacancy commentary is in the 2026-04-17 briefing, https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/384449. The Sep/Aug refinancing notices are https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260910/140120260831529121.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260828/140120260827527278.pdf. All are MEL documents, so this is one source family.

findings.finding: Logistics J-REIT peers are buying back units below NAV. GLP J-REIT announced a 10bn yen (1.6%) buyback with its Aug-2026 results on 2026-10-15 (+0.7% next day, ETF +0.17%). LaSalle Logiport, MEL's co-investment partner, announced asset sales plus a 10bn yen (4.3%) buyback on 2026-09-18 (+5.3%). MEL itself announced a buyback with its 2025-04-17 results (+2.0%). In Oct-2025 MEL stated that its unit price was below 1x NAV.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-04-17, results plus a buyback announcement: +2.00% next session against ETF +0.08%. 2025-10-16 and 2026-04-16 came with no buyback: -0.16% and -3.21%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing in MEL's own disclosures since 2026-07 signals a buyback, and its sale cash (about 2.7bn yen retained) went into the 3.1bn MJ Logipark Daito 1 acquisition on 2026-07-24. A buyback would therefore need a new asset sale announced in the same batch, which is uncertain. If the market expected one, MEL would have outperformed the REIT ETF after the GLP and LLR announcements, and it has not (-4.3% against -4.6% over 20 days). Sized as a probability (about 25-35%) times about +1.5-2%.
findings.independence: LLR's sale and buyback (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260918538486.pdf). MEL's own 2025-04-17 buyback decision (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20250417/140120250417517594/). MEL's statement that the price is below NAV and that sale cash may go to buybacks (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/382754, https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/384449). The cash constraint cuts against it: the 2026-07-22 Daito acquisition notice, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260722597318.pdf.

findings.finding: The Aug-2026 DPU is pre-released at 3,112 yen, which includes about 671m yen of gain on the Kazo 1/2 sale. MEL's record is small beats against the latest forecast: Aug-2025 2,829 against an initial 2,764 (+2.4%), and Feb-2026 2,835 against 2,832 (+0.1%; ex-OPD 2,600 against 2,547). So a small beat is likely, but it lands inside guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +2.4% DPU beat on the 2025-10-16 print came with -0.16%, and the 2026-04-16 beat (kabutan: 上振れ着地) with -3.21%. Beats on the reported period have not lifted this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, because the revision pre-released it. It is kept at almost zero only because it is a sourced fact bearing on the print.
findings.independence: Past actual-versus-forecast figures come from the 決算短信 of 2025-10-16 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251016/140120251016574624.pdf) and 2025-04-17 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250417/140120250417517598.pdf).

outside_window.finding: Lease-up of the two vacated properties: one carries a stated rent gap of about 10% that could lift NOI after re-leasing, the other sits in a soft submarket. NOI recovery is a story for the Aug-2027 period and later.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: the Aug-2026 period is pre-released (3,112) and Feb-2027 (2,836) may be revised a little for the Daito acquisition and refinancing costs. Returns: a buyback is possible (peer wave, and MEL did one in Apr-2025) but not signalled, and cash is tight. New guide: Aug-2027 DPU appears for the first time, against the 2,936 annual-average target. Quarter: J-REIT semiannual, so 進捗率 is not meaningful; DPU actual against forecast has been a 0-2.4% beat.
baseline_tension: Nothing found beats the baseline. The run-up is the sector's, the short register is empty, and the margin-long overhang (lean -0.28) has no company-specific trigger. The strongest positive the release could carry is a buyback, possibly funded by a newly announced asset sale with gain recycling (as LLR did, +5.3%). I looked for it in MEL's disclosures and found no signal, so it is sized as a probability.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: Rule 1 (a negative on public series means p_up toward 50) was already met with p_up at 50, and the guidance negative turns on what the release ADDS (the new Aug-2027 guide), so its size stands.
